headline: Setting September 2027 meeting dates, plus approval of minutes from the prior meeting.
summary: Dates for the September 2027 meetings will be set.
location: First Floor Meeting Room 1-2 (#114), Bristol City Hall, 111 North Main St., Bristol, CT
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Board of Assessment Appeals 
 
In Person Only Meeting  
 
 
 
 
 
The regular Board of Assessment Appeals meeting will be held on November 18, 2026 at 10:30 
a.m. in the First Floor Meeting Room 1-2 (#114) at Bristol City Hall, 111 North Main St., Bristol, 
CT  
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of the minutes from the November 5, 2026 BAA Meeting 
3. Set September 2027 Meeting Dates  
4. Adjournment 
  
Per Order of the Chairperson, Ann Marie Heering
